verdict.rationale: Scribe documents a synchronous endpoint, POST /aiservices/scribe/transcribe, that accepts a single local audio or video file up to 100 MB and two hours. The docs also publish the accepted formats: WAV, M4A, MP3, MP4 and WebM. The endpoint appears in the published OpenAPI catalog, and a probe confirmed that catalog is live. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of an actual file upload against the endpoint and its limits.

support.subject: As a developer, I can submit a local audio or video file for transcription through a documented API endpoint, with accepted formats and size limits published

citations.quote: POST /aiservices/scribe/transcribe accepts a single local audio or video file up to 100 MB and two hours
Transcribes WAV, M4A, MP3, MP4, and WebM files
